title: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala
summary: Established that Parliament cannot amend the basic structure of the Constitution
key_points: Basic structure of Constitution is inviolable
Parliament's amending power under Article 368 is limited
Fundamental rights are part of basic structure

title: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India
summary: Expanded the scope of Article 21 (Right to Life and Personal Liberty) to include right to travel abroad
key_points: Article 21 includes right to travel abroad
Natural justice principles must be followed

title: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan
outcome: Guidelines for sexual harassment at workplace
summary: Laid down comprehensive guidelines for prevention of sexual harassment at workplace (Vishaka Guidelines)
key_points: Sexual harassment violates fundamental rights under Articles 14, 19, and 21
Employers must provide safe work environment

title: Shanti Star Builders v. Narayan Totame
summary: Upheld tenant rights against illegal eviction, emphasized need for proper notice and due process

title: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation v. Darius Shapur Chenai
summary: Clarified the requirements for establishing adverse possession claim
key_points: Possession must be continuous for 12 years
Possession must be hostile to true owner
Burden of proof on person claiming adverse possession

title: State of Maharashtra v. Madhukar Narayan Mardikar
outcome: Character evidence inadmissible in rape cases
summary: Held that past sexual history of victim is irrelevant in rape cases
key_points: Character of victim irrelevant in rape trials
Past sexual conduct cannot be used to discredit victim
Focus should be on the alleged incident
Dignity of victim must be protected

title: Suresh Kumar Koushal v. Naz Foundation
outcome: Later overturned by Navtej Singh Johar
summary: Upheld constitutionality of IPC Section 377 criminalizing homosexual acts (later overruled)
key_points: Held that sexual minorities are minuscule
Later overruled in 2018 by larger bench
Historical case in LGBTQ rights evolution

title: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India
summary: Partially struck down Section 377 IPC decriminalizing consensual homosexual acts between adults
key_points: Consensual sex between adults is not criminal
Discrimination based on sexual orientation violates Articles 14, 15, 21
Right to dignity and privacy upheld

title: Satyabrata Ghose v. Mugneeram Bangur & Co.
summary: Explained doctrine of frustration of contract under Section 56 of Indian Contract Act
key_points: Performance must become unlawful or physically impossible

title: Central Inland Water Transport Corporation v. Brojo Nath Ganguly
summary: Struck down unreasonable termination clause in employment contract, applied Article 14 to contractual obligations
key_points: Fundamental rights apply to State instrumentalities

title: Shah Bano Begum v. Mohammed Ahmed Khan
outcome: Maintenance under CrPC 125 applicable to Muslim women
summary: Held that Muslim women entitled to maintenance under Section 125 CrPC after divorce
key_points: Section 125 CrPC applies to all religions
Right to maintenance transcends religious boundaries
Led to enactment of Muslim Women Act 1986

title: Shayara Bano v. Union of India (Triple Talaq Case)
summary: Declared practice of triple talaq (talaq-e-biddat) unconstitutional and violative of Article 14
key_points: Led to Muslim Women Protection of Rights Act 2019

title: Indian Medical Association v. V.P. Shantha
outcome: Medical services covered under Consumer Protection Act
summary: Held that medical services constitute 'service' under Consumer Protection Act 1986

title: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
outcome: Section 66A of IT Act struck down
summary: Struck down Section 66A of IT Act 2000 as unconstitutional restriction on freedom of speech
key_points: Vague and overbroad provisions struck down
Online speech has same protection as offline

title: M.C. Mehta v. Union of India (Oleum Gas Leak Case)
summary: Established the principle of absolute liability for hazardous or inherently dangerous activities
key_points: Compensation commensurate with magnitude and capacity

title: Indian Council for Enviro-Legal Action v. Union of India
summary: Affirmed the 'Polluter Pays' principle and ordered remediation of polluted land
key_points: Right to clean environment is fundamental right

title: Air India v. Nergesh Meerza
outcome: Gender discriminatory service conditions struck down
summary: Struck down discriminatory service conditions for air hostesses based on marriage and pregnancy
key_points: Marriage/pregnancy cannot be ground for termination

title: Novartis AG v. Union of India
summary: Rejected Novartis patent application for Glivec, upheld Section 3(d) of Patents Act
key_points: Enhanced efficacy required for new form

title: Vodafone International Holdings v. Union of India
outcome: Offshore transaction not taxable in India
summary: Held that offshore share transfer between two foreign entities not taxable in India
key_points: Look at substance, not form of transaction
Offshore transactions outside Indian tax jurisdiction
Led to retrospective amendment of Income Tax Act
